verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a DevSecOps platform like GitLab, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no retention policies, deletion controls, or data-lifecycle settings. Self-hosting options, the Agent Platform on/off toggle, audit logs, and community reports about backups are adjacent topics and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
